Gold Price Guide

Gold Price Today Sargodha – Complete Guide to Gold Prices

Understand the gold price today Sargodha market, how 24K, 22K, 21K and 18K gold are valued, and how per-gram, per-tola and 10-gram prices are calculated.

📍 Sargodha, Punjab, Pakistan 📅 Updated September 2026 SM Gold Sargodha

Searching for the gold price today in Sargodha usually means you want to know how much gold is worth before making a purchase, selling old jewellery, comparing jewellery shops or planning a new design.

The term gold price Sargodha can refer to different things. Some customers mean the market value of pure gold, while others are asking about the final price of jewellery. These two figures are related, but they are not always identical.

Important: Gold prices are market-sensitive and can change over time. Online figures should be treated as references. Confirm the latest local quotation before completing a purchase or sale.

What Is the Gold Price Today in Sargodha?

The gold price today Sargodha represents the market value of gold at a particular purity and weight. The number can change because international gold markets and the Pakistani currency market can move throughout the day.

When comparing the gold price today in Sargodha, always check the purity, weight unit, date and timing of the quotation.

Gold Price Quick Facts

24K High-purity gold reference used for market comparisons.
11.664g Approximately one traditional tola.
10g Common metric unit for price comparison.

24K Gold Price in Sargodha

24K gold represents very high-purity gold and is commonly used as a benchmark when discussing the underlying value of gold.

Customers searching for the 24k gold price Sargodha should confirm whether the quoted figure is per gram, per 10 grams or per tola.

A quotation in one unit cannot be compared directly with another until the units have been converted.

22K Gold Price in Sargodha

22K gold contains approximately 91.6% pure gold. It is widely associated with traditional jewellery designs and is commonly discussed when comparing jewellery prices.

When checking the 22k gold price Sargodha, compare it with another 22K quotation using the same weight and market timing.

21K Gold Price in Sargodha

21K gold contains approximately 87.5% pure gold. It is an important jewellery purity in the Pakistani market.

The 21k gold price Sargodha can be expressed per gram or per tola. Customers should confirm both purity and weight before comparing prices.

18K Gold Price in Sargodha

18K gold contains approximately 75% pure gold. Because it has a different gold content, its underlying metal value is different from 21K, 22K and 24K.

Customers checking the 18k gold price Sargodha should compare 18K with other 18K quotations, rather than directly comparing it with a higher-purity gold benchmark.

Gold Price Per Gram in Sargodha

The gold price per gram Sargodha is useful for small jewellery purchases because many lighter items can be discussed using grams.

A gram is a measurement of weight, while karat is a measurement of purity. You need both pieces of information to understand the actual gold value of an item.

Gold Price Per Tola in Sargodha

Gold is traditionally quoted using the tola in Pakistan. One tola is approximately 11.664 grams.

To estimate a per-gram amount from a per-tola price, divide the quoted per-tola amount by approximately 11.664.

Example: If a hypothetical gold price were Rs 200,000 per tola, the approximate per-gram amount would be: Rs 200,000 ÷ 11.664 ≈ Rs 17,147 per gram. This is only a mathematical example, not a live market quote.

Gold Price for 10 Grams in Sargodha

Some customers search for gold price 10 gram Sargodha because ten grams is a convenient metric comparison point.

Once the per-gram rate for the correct purity is known, multiplying it by ten provides an estimated ten-gram metal value.

Gold Price vs Gold Jewellery Price

The biggest difference customers should understand is that a market gold price does not automatically equal the final price of a finished jewellery item.

The finished jewellery amount may also include:

  • Net gold weight.
  • Gold purity.
  • Workmanship or labour.
  • Design complexity.
  • Stone or decorative work.
  • Wastage policies.
  • Other applicable charges.

Why Does Gold Price Change?

The gold rate in Sargodha can move because the local market is connected to wider financial and commodity markets.

  • International gold-market movements.
  • USD to PKR exchange-rate changes.
  • Local supply and demand.
  • Market sentiment.
  • Timing of the quoted rate.
  • Local trading conditions.

How to Compare Gold Prices Correctly

  1. Make sure both quotations use the same karat.
  2. Confirm whether the price is per gram, per 10 grams or per tola.
  3. Check the date and update time.
  4. Confirm the actual weight of the jewellery.
  5. Ask whether the quote is a metal benchmark or a final jewellery price.
  6. Ask about workmanship and other applicable charges.

Gold Market in Sargodha

Customers researching the gold market Sargodha may compare online prices with information available from local jewellery businesses.

Online data is useful for understanding broader market movements, but local shop quotations may vary according to update timing, transaction type, purity, weight, workmanship and market conditions.

Sarafa Bazar Sargodha Gold Price

People searching for sarafa bazar Sargodha gold price are often trying to compare the local jewellery market with published online benchmarks.

When doing this comparison, always make sure both figures refer to the same purity and weight. A 24K per-tola benchmark and a 21K per-gram jewellery quotation are not directly comparable.

How to Calculate the Value of Gold Jewellery

A simple starting point for estimating the metal component is:

Estimated Gold Value = Net Gold Weight × Current Price Per Gram

The final jewellery price may then include workmanship, design-related charges, stone costs, wastage and other applicable amounts.

Questions to Ask Before Buying Gold Jewellery

  • What is the current gold price?
  • What purity is this item?
  • What is the net gold weight?
  • Is the rate quoted per gram or per tola?
  • What workmanship charges apply?
  • Are stones or other components charged separately?
  • What is the final amount payable?
